# OTel SIG Meeting Notes

> A searchable archive of OpenTelemetry Special Interest Group (SIG) meeting transcripts, meeting notes, and AI-generated summaries. Content is scraped from Zoom recordings and enriched with attendee lists and agendas sourced from Google Docs.

## Resources

- Web UI: https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/
- Manifest (JSON): https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/manifest.json
- Full LLM reference: https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/llms-full.txt
- Source: https://github.com/julianocosta89/sig-meeting-notes

## How to find content

### 1. Start with the manifest

Fetch the manifest to discover all SIGs and their meetings:

    GET https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/manifest.json

Response shape:

    {
      "generated_at": "2026-03-02T20:28:12Z",
      "min_date": "2025-06-16",
      "max_date": "2026-02-27",
      "sigs": [
        {
          "slug": "Collector-SIG",
          "name": "Collector SIG",
          "meeting_notes_url": "https://docs.google.com/document/d/...",
          "repository_url": "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector",
          "meeting_count": 28,
          "meetings": [
            { "date": "2026-02-04", "duration_minutes": 42, "has_summary": true, "has_meeting_notes": true }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }

Top-level fields:
- `generated_at` — UTC timestamp of last manifest build
- `min_date` / `max_date` — earliest and latest meeting dates across all SIGs
- `sigs` — array of SIG objects sorted alphabetically by slug

SIG fields:
- `slug` — URL-safe identifier (used in content URLs)
- `name` — human-readable display name
- `meeting_notes_url` — link to the SIG's Google Doc (may be empty)
- `repository_url` — link to the SIG's GitHub repo (may be empty)
- `meeting_count` — total number of meetings for this SIG

Meeting fields:
- `date` — ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `duration_minutes` — meeting length in minutes
- `has_summary` — true if an AI summary exists (skip fetching summary.md when false)
- `has_meeting_notes` — true if meeting notes exist (skip fetching meeting-notes.md when false)

### 2. Fetch individual files

Each meeting has up to three files. Build the URL from the SIG slug and date:

    https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/content/{slug}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{file}

Files (in recommended read order):

- `summary.md` — AI-generated summary (short, best starting point; only exists when `has_summary` is true)
- `meeting-notes.md` — attendees and agenda (only exists when `has_meeting_notes` is true)
- `transcript.md` — full Zoom transcript (always exists; can be very long)

### 3. Typical workflow

1. Fetch `manifest.json` to find SIG slugs, date ranges, and availability flags
2. Filter to the SIG and date range you need using `slug` and `date` fields
3. Read `summary.md` first (check `has_summary`) — gives a concise overview
4. If you need attendees or agenda, read `meeting-notes.md` (check `has_meeting_notes`)
5. Fall back to `transcript.md` only for verbatim quotes or the full discussion

### 4. Examples

Get the AI summary for the Collector SIG meeting on 2026-02-04:

    GET https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/content/Collector-SIG/2026-02-04/summary.md

Get the meeting notes (attendees + agenda) for the same meeting:

    GET https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/content/Collector-SIG/2026-02-04/meeting-notes.md

Get the full transcript:

    GET https://julianocosta89.github.io/sig-meeting-notes/content/Collector-SIG/2026-02-04/transcript.md

## File formats

### transcript.md

    SIG: Collector SIG
    Date: 2026-02-04
    Duration: 42 minutes
    ============================================================

    ## Zoom Recording Transcript

    **Speaker Name** MM:SS utterance text

Header fields are on lines 1-4, separated from the body by a line of `=` characters. The body starts with a `## Zoom Recording Transcript` heading followed by timestamped speaker lines.

### meeting-notes.md

    ## Meeting Notes

    ### Attendees
    - Name 1 (Company)
    - Name 2 (Company)

    ### Agenda
    - Item 1
    - Item 2

Contains two subsections: Attendees (bulleted list of participants) and Agenda (bulleted list of discussion items, may include links).

### summary.md

    ## Key Topics
    - Topic 1 summary
    - Topic 2 summary

    ## Action Items
    - Action item 1
    - Action item 2

    ## Participants
    Comma-separated list of participant names

Contains up to three sections: Key Topics (main discussion points), Action Items (follow-ups), and Participants (names). Generated by GPT-4o-mini.

## Coverage

Covers OpenTelemetry SIG meetings from the public OTel recordings spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SYKfjYhZdm2Wh2Cl6KVQalKg_m4NhTPZqq-8SzEVO6s). New meetings are fetched automatically on weekdays and published to this site.
